From today, Runna subscribers can use the brand-new "Heat Adaptation" feature, which automatically adjusts pace targets based on the temperature and humidity of the user's location. Details are as follows.

Runna Launches New Training Tool to Help Users Cope with Hot Weather

The personalised running coach app Runna announced today the launch of three updates, aimed at providing users with comprehensive support throughout their entire training cycle, covering every aspect from training in hot weather to post-race recovery.

The brand-new "Heat Adaptation" feature officially launches today, helping users find cooler time slots for running, and recommending adjusted pace targets based on the "feels-like" temperature, training duration, and specific workout sessions.

The "Heat Adaptation" feature uses colour coding to display the weather forecast for each time slot, allowing users to identify the best running times at a glance and plan their training accordingly.

The following is Runna's introduction of this new feature:

Runna also announced the relaunch of its "Post-Race Recovery Plan" feature. As soon as users open a race plan for events ranging from 5km to 50km, the system automatically generates a corresponding recovery plan. Steph Kessell, Runna's Head Coach and former Olympian, said that these plans are designed by professional coaches to help runners "reduce the risk of overtraining or injury".

Lastly, the platform announced that a new feature called "Upcoming Plans" will be launched in August. Users can pre-arrange multiple training plans, and the system will seamlessly transition between plans, further streamlining the long-term training process.

The following are the benefits of Runna's "Upcoming Plans" feature:

Plan your entire year's training in minutes: Runners can stack races, mid-term goals, and training phases to see a full overview of the year. Zero admin between plans: No need to rebuild or start from scratch—when one plan ends and the next begins, your preferred training schedule, projected finish times, and current fitness status are automatically carried over. Flexibility in your hands: Each plan can be edited, swapped, or deleted at any time, giving runners complete control over their training experience. Built for progress: Every plan is carefully designed by Runna's coaching team based on proven training principles to support sustainable progress, recovery, and race-day performance.
